company.name: Touchmark
company.shortDescription: Touchmark is an award-winning developer, owner, and operator of full-service retirement communities throughout North America.
company.description: Touchmark at Meadow Lake Village inspiring as the landscape is, they are equally as inspired by the rich diversity of their residents. They feel privileged to enhance the daily experience of active seniors and support pursuing interests and passions. Their community uniquely addresses the needs of a dynamic population eager to move into the next adventure. They embrace a philosophy of expanding horizons and limitless possibilities. They encourage residents at every stage to continue discovering and chasing their passions.

caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
